description:
The Tallo database is a global collection of 498,838 georeferenced and
taxonomically standardized individual-tree records compiled across 61,856
sampling sites globally. Spanning 5,163 tree species, 1,453 genera, and 187
plant families, Tallo provides individual-tree measurements of stem
diameter (DBH), total tree height, and mean crown radius across all major
terrestrial biomes.

The database was created to support research in forest ecology, remote
sensing, and global vegetation carbon modeling. It is described in detail in
[Jucker et al. (2022)](https://doi.org/10.1111/gcb.16302).

This dataset is available through BigQuery at
`earth-engine-public-data.tallo.tallo_v1`.

gee:schema.description: Unique identifier for each individual tree record in the Tallo database
gee:schema.name: tree_id

gee:schema.description: Taxonomic family of the tree (e.g. Rubiaceae, Pinaceae, Fabaceae)
gee:schema.name: family

gee:schema.description: Taxonomic genus of the tree (e.g. Coprosma, Pinus, Quercus)
gee:schema.name: genus

gee:schema.description: Binomial scientific name of the tree species (e.g. Coprosma ochracea)
gee:schema.name: species

gee:schema.description: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84)
gee:schema.name: latitude

gee:schema.description: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84)
gee:schema.name: longitude

gee:schema.description: Stem diameter at breast height (DBH) in centimeters
gee:schema.name: stem_diameter_cm

gee:schema.description: Mean crown radius of the tree in meters
gee:schema.name: crown_radius_m

gee:schema.description: Outlier flag for tree height measurement (Y = outlier, N = valid)
gee:schema.name: height_outlier

gee:schema.description: Outlier flag for crown radius measurement (Y = outlier, N = valid)
gee:schema.name: crown_radius_outlier

gee:schema.description: Numerical identifier linking record to contributing data source citation
gee:schema.name: reference_id
